compute.convention: §98 (boxes.core.Meter); per token k fresh write passes + 1 fresh read pass (no KV cache)

delta_cos.def: 173-1 / halt173.dir_fields: per pass p the MEAN over items of cos(Sd_p, Sd_p-1), Sd = the flattened delta-head state S[:, H_ADD:], consecutive states (M_0 = zero; zero-norm pairs skipped, counted); within = p and p - 1 in one token, across = token j's first pass vs token j - 1's last (j >= 2); greedy 4x4 run

delta_inc_cos.def: median over items of cos(dS_p, dS_p+1), dS_p = the full state after pass p - before it

s181.kprime_index_def: at k' passes per token the pass index is t = (j - 1) * k' + q (the passes performed, consecutively); skip_matrix keeps t = (j - 1) * k + q
